title: The inclusion of the quasi-coherent derived category has a right adjoint

standard_prerequisites.name: A functor has a right adjoint precisely when every object sits in a distinguished triangle with a quasi-coherent first term and a last term orthogonal to all quasi-coherent objects
standard_prerequisites.use: Reduces the construction of the adjoint to producing such a triangle for every object.

standard_prerequisites.name: On an affine scheme the inclusion of the quasi-coherent derived category has the right adjoint given by the coherator
standard_prerequisites.use: Provides the base case of the induction.

standard_prerequisites.name: The induction principle on quasi-compact opens reduces the statement about a quasi-compact quasi-separated scheme to the base case and to a union of two quasi-compact opens
standard_prerequisites.use: Organises the proof into the base case and the union step.

standard_prerequisites.name: Pushforwards and pullbacks along open immersions preserve the quasi-coherent derived category, and the standard exact sequence relates the pushforwards from two opens and their intersection
standard_prerequisites.use: Produces the required triangle in the union step and the orthogonality computation.

core_obligations: Record the criterion for the existence of the right adjoint in the form of a distinguished triangle whose first term is quasi-coherent and whose last term is orthogonal to all quasi-coherent objects, and reduce to constructing such a triangle for each object (proof lines 5051-5060).

Note that on a scheme where the comparison functor between the two derived categories is an equivalence the adjoint exists, because the right derived functor of the coherator is a right adjoint to that comparison; in particular the affine case is settled (proof lines 5055-5063).

Set up the induction principle on quasi-compact opens, so that it remains to prove the statement for a union of two quasi-compact opens assuming it for the two opens and their intersection (proof lines 5055-5070).

In the union step, take the displayed distinguished triangle relating an object to the pushforwards of its restrictions to the two opens and to their intersection; this triangle is the one whose terms have the required properties once the quasi-coherence and orthogonality are verified (proof lines 5071-5085).

For an open immersion into the union of the two opens, choose the triangle exhibiting the object on the smaller open as quasi-coherent plus an orthogonal object, using the criterion in the if and only if form, and push it forward along the open immersion (proof lines 5086-5105).

Verify the two required properties in this pushed forward triangle: the first term is quasi-coherent by the quasi-coherence of direct images, and the last term stays orthogonal because the pullback of a quasi-coherent object along the open immersion is again quasi-coherent, at which point adjointness of the pullback finishes the computation (proof lines 5106-5119).
proof_roadmap: Reduce to the triangle criterion for a right adjoint (proof lines 5051-5060).
Base case: affine schemes, where the coherator gives the adjoint (proof lines 5055-5063).
Union step: the Mayer-Vietoris triangle and, for a single open immersion, the pushed forward triangle with quasi-coherence and orthogonality verified (proof lines 5071-5119).
difficulty_reason: 69 行、结构清楚：先用「右伴随存在的判别法」把问题化为「每个对象都能放进一个三角形，首项拟凝聚、末项与所有拟凝聚对象正交」；仿射情形由 coherator 立即给出；一般情形用拟紧开集上的归纳原理，并集步要作相对 Mayer-Vietoris 三角形、再对单个开浸入取三角形并推前，随后核对两条性质（首项拟凝聚用直接像的拟凝聚性；末项正交用拉回把拟凝聚对象拉回成拟凝聚 + 拉回-推前伴随）。承重步骤（判别法、并集论证、两条性质的核对）都在 span 内；8 处引用（4 同章、4 跨章）作导航桩。注：作者给了两个证明（First proof 完整写出、第二个更大），本卡收的是完整的那个。
